title: Archive through September 08, 2002 - Anonymous (Sunday, August 25, 2002 - 10:20 pm)
content: I had just come off the mid-night watch, taken a quick cold shower. I lay down for a few minutes as reveille would sound at 5:30 a.m., and I would have to get up again. My neck and shoulders had not yet hit the pillow, when I realized, that as I touched my eyes, I was no longer myself. I was a presence, aware of the yellow lined green clouds and, was being invited to jump into the turquoise sky. I did have a feeling like a golden spider web that vibrated to the universal sounds and feelings. I was in love. I heard a voice tell me, I could “not remain” there, I would “have to go back”. I asked “why not” and was told that I would “have to finish what I had started out to accomplish”. I acknowledged okay and was back in the rack. I noted the 1st class EM cover his eyes and head with his blanket and as he turned over. I noted his disbelief of what he had just seen. I had had a NDE without the aspect of Death. I went on to finish the full week with less than an hours sleep daily. I go there regularly and commune with God directly as the Presence plays with my hair and drops down to observe through my eyes at will. When I direct its attention to some problem or health problem someone has, I move out of its way and channel. The Healing takes place between it and the objective. I have slipped on Ice and been lifted and set back very gently. I talk to God and a softbluish light appears in my cab and, when I try to shut off the light with the switch I note that it is not physical in our terms. It is the Quetzal of the Aztec's, The presence of James Redfield's Book Secrets of Shambahala. Sometimes children that are not able to get out of their strollers, looking with focused intent, look around for someone and emphatically exclaim while pointing with their finger "GOD!" – Today I teach others to see life through the point of the brain that does imagination and seeking. To use the Amegdela switch and attuning their attention become one with their brushes, medium and canvass. Allow their emotional energy to arise, with their spirituality. Intentionally focus with that feeling and wait. The Presence will transform it into 100% Time and Reality. I love it. The Me in You, the You in Me, There is only "I AM.'

arrival.other_being_detail: A “Presence” that later is described as playing with the experiencer’s hair and observing through their eyes; also referenced as “the Quetzal of the Aztec's” and “The presence of James Redfield's Book Secrets of Shambahala.”

environment.environment_other_detail: “yellow lined green clouds” and being invited to jump into the “turquoise sky.”

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told they would “have to finish what I had started out to accomplish.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Occurred while lying down after coming off “the mid-night watch,” just before reveille; described as “a NDE without the aspect of Death.”

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Speaks of communing with “God” directly; also references Aztec “Quetzal” and Shambhala-related material.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Described “being invited to jump into the turquoise sky” and a “golden spider web” vibration/attunement; later ongoing communion/channeling/healing claims.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Immediate shift into being a “presence” with environment and voice instruction to return; no tunnel or life review described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Explicitly states it was “a NDE without the aspect of Death.” Reports ongoing repeated access (“I go there regularly”), channeling/healing, being physically lifted after slipping on ice, and a “softbluish light” in the cab that is “not physical.”
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was a presence, aware of the yellow lined green clouds and, was being invited to jump into the turquoise sky.”; “I was in love.”; Voice: I could “not remain” there, I would “have to go back” and “have to finish what I had started out to accomplish”; “The Me in You, the You in Me, There is only ‘I AM.’”
